title: current.json
description: Commit pointer pub/current.json, returned byte by GET /v1/version (mutable object). sig is Ed25519 over the canonical form of this object (without the sig property). Verify over every property received except sig (including unknown).

api_schema_version.description: Version of api/contract the release conforms to (api_schema_version is in /v1/version).

minimum_revision.description: Oldest from_revision with an update package. Equals revision for a snapshot-only release (minimum_revision <= revision).

manifest.description: pub-relative path of this revision's manifest (equals manifests/{revision}.json).

manifest_sha256.description: sha256 of the manifest bytes exactly as stored and served.

published_at.description: dataset_published_at: when this revision first became current.

checked_at.description: Last run that confirmed this revision is current; refreshed by the no-change flag.

expires_at.description: checked_at + 14 days. Past it the app shows 'updates stale' and keeps working.

signature.description: Ed25519 signature (64 bytes), standard base64 with padding.
